invest10k.rule: $10,000 at poll close. Each signal of the election's frozen trading rule, in time order, stakes min($1,000, cash left, what real execution could fill) and is held to resolution; ending value = cash + payouts, net of fees and the half-spread. No reinvestment during the night (payouts arrive at resolution).

br2026r1.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee

br2026r2.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee

br2026r2gov.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee

il2026.execution: walk of the recorded order book 60 s after the signal as a limit order (levels leaving >= 5c of edge), at the average cost of a $1,000 walk; taker fee 0
il2026.outcome: provisional count; markets not yet resolved
il2026.note: totals only: the three bets are one event (Likud's seat band); bet times and the bankroll path are not published because they come from the 2026 count (private-research data)

hu2026.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee (analysis/hu_score.py fills)

mx2024.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee (analysis/mx_score.py; no signal fired)
